subject: Request: make-good credits & trial extension for sustained latency on /v1/generate
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Sudden increase in latency impacting our triage workflows

Grace —

Sorry to escalate via email but this is urgent for us. Starting ~03:00 PDT yesterday and intermittently through this morning we've seen median p95 latency for /v1/generate jump from ~420ms to ~2.8s. Our ingestion pipeline stalled in a few test environments and a handful of production jobs timed out. We raised a support ticket but the elevated latency window lasted ~9 hours and caused service interruptions for our triage team.

Given the scale of impact (we run patient-facing classification pipelines) we're asking Redwood for a good-faith make-good: apply credits to our account to cover excess token cost during the incident window and extend our trial by 30 days while we validate stability. We're also requesting the incident timeline and any mitigations you ran during the event.

Happy to hop on a quick call — Jordan (cc'd Elena, our CTO)

--
Jordan Price
Head of Platform
Nimbus Health
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Sudden increase in latency impacting our triage workflows

Jordan — thanks for flagging and absolutely sorry for the disruption. I've opened an internal incident and looped Marissa (customer success) to coordinate. We're preparing a timeline and initial analysis; attaching an early incident-timeline.csv for visibility.

Proposed next steps:
- Internal sync (Redwood) to confirm root cause and mitigation (ETA by EOD PT).
- Draft a credit proposal + trial extension to make Nimbus whole while we stabilize.
- Offer a technical post-mortem and 1:1 runbook session with your infra team.

Marissa — assigning to you: can you own the credit proposal and work with Finance? I suggest a preliminary offer of 20% credit on token spend during the incident window + 30-day trial extension; open to adjustments after ops confirms impact.

I'll follow up with the ops notes once available.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident-timeline.csv (CSV, 6KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:22:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: make-good credits & trial extension for sustained latency on /v1/generate

Team — attaching the initial latency-analysis.pdf produced by infra. Summary: regression introduced in autoscaler config change pushed 2026-10-29 02:40 UTC; sustained elevated queueing led to the ~9 hour window reported. Estimated excess token spend for Nimbus during the window: ~$4,200 (customer usage spikes + retries).

Options for commercial remediation:
- Option A (conservative): One-time credit equal to 100% of estimated excess token spend (~$4,200) + 30-day trial extension.
- Option B (conciliatory): 150% credit (~$6,300) to cover operational rework costs + 45-day trial extension.

I recommend Option A to keep precedent reasonable; happy to escalate to Markus for approval if we want Option B. Finance will need a formal approval to apply credits.

Attachments: latency-analysis.pdf

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T12:08:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: make-good credits & trial extension for sustained latency on /v1/generate

Marissa / Grace — I agree with starting at Option A. Nimbus is a high-touch account and retaining trust is priority. If legal/finance are OK, I support the $4.2k credit + 30 days.

Can we also offer a complimentary runbook session and a dedicated SRE contact for 60 days? That will cost us little and helps prevent churn.

If approved, please create a HubSpot note (I've linked the company record) and include a simple credit memo to apply to their next invoice.

-Sean
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:15:00Z
Subject: Approval: Nimbus credit request (prelim)

Thanks for the context. I approve Option A (one-time credit equal to estimated excess spend: $4,200) and the 30-day trial extension. Please route to Finance for a formal credit entry and confirm the GL code. Also yes to the runbook session — product and SRE should partner.

Michael — can you sign off on the accounting treatment and make the promo code / credit memo? Once Finance confirms I'll ask Ops to close the incident PM and we can send a formal customer communication.

-Markus
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Approval: Nimbus credit request (prelim) — completed actions

Finance completed the credit entry this morning. Details:
- One-time account credit: $4,200 applied to Nimbus Health (account id 98765)
- Promo code issued: NIMBUS-MAKEGOOD-1126 (applies to next invoice, expires 2027-01-31)
- Trial extension: 30 days applied to existing trial window (new expiration 2027-02-15)
- Jira: INF-2024 updated with remediation notes and post-mortem draft (link attached).

Marissa — please send the final customer email with the applied credit details and attach the redacted post-mortem. Jordan / Elena — apologies again for the impact; we completed root cause fixes and are scheduling the runbook session for the week of Nov 15.

Attachments: promo-credit-invoice-stub.xlsx

-Rishi
Director, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: make-good credits & trial extension for sustained latency on /v1/generate — resolution

Jordan / Elena — thank you for your patience. Per internal approvals and Finance action, we've applied a one-time credit of $4,200 to Nimbus Health and issued a promo code (NIMBUS-MAKEGOOD-1126) for the next invoice. Your trial has been extended by 30 days (new expiration 2027-02-15).

I've attached a redacted post-mortem and the same promo stub for your records. We'll follow up to schedule the runbook session during the week of Nov 15 — Marissa will reach out with available slots.

Again, very sorry for the disruption; we take incidents like this seriously and appreciate the partnership as we improve our autoscaling safeguards.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: latency-analysis.pdf (redacted), promo-credit-invoice-stub.xlsx
